sentences.en: He makes himself accessible to all who seek his counsel.
sentences.zh: 他向所有寻求建议的人敞开了心扉。

sentences.en: Sami humbled himself down and agreed to go to counseling.
sentences.zh: 萨米谦卑下来，同意去咨询一下。

sentences.en: Before his departure, the saint counseled old man Mickal.
sentences.zh: 在出发前，圣人给迈克尔老人提了一些建议。

senses.zh: 忠告；讨论；商议；决策；法律顾问 -

mnemonic: 联想记忆：coun（看作court，法庭）+ sel（看作sell，卖）→在法庭上卖弄技巧的人→律师
